limitations: Bounded single-date query snapshot over the full retained entity manifest; it is not full validation-period or later-year operational coverage.
Cold means the first pass after a database-process restart. Operating-system caches were not controlled or flushed.
Small populations: the reported tail percentile is a nearest-rank maximum, not a service-level tail prediction.
Label agreement is a diagnostic on an enriched simulated cohort, not evidence of fraud utility.
The frozen graph PageRank projection did not converge at its declared iteration limit, and community detection includes isolates; no algorithm parameter was tuned.
No provider score was reused or generated, so decision impact and CPST remain unavailable pending the separately approved measured comparison.
Resource samples are coarse observations. Cgroup counters cover the latest container-start lifetime, including a later plan inspection; they are not per-query peaks.
The original contaminated first pass is excluded. A separate first-pass replacement ran after all regression checks; the warm schedule is unchanged.
relevance_interpretation: Diagnostic only: label agreement on an enriched simulated cohort is not evidence of fraud utility. The counts beside this note are computed from the evaluator label join.
plan_observation: The first query's inner SQL plan was captured after the timed schedule and is attached as sql-inner-plan.json; it is not another benchmark pass. No index or query parameter changed after observing results.
resource_accounting_stage: After service shutdown and before the final small JSON and Markdown publication; the publication byte count is recorded separately.
first_pass_protocol: Replacement first pass after a database-process restart that followed all tests; no operating-system cache flush.
